name: Taha Bouhsine
title: Co-founder of azetta.ai
bio: Host of Iskanmagar transmissions. Co-founder of azetta.ai, previous founder of the research community ML Nomads, and AI Google Developer Expert helping builders from underrepresented communities learn and create at the edge of AI.
more: AI Google Developer Expert passionate about democratizing AI and ML education. Previous founder of ML Nomads, a global research community bringing together researchers and practitioners from underrepresented regions. Currently building azetta.ai to make AI accessible and practical for builders everywhere.
